notes.title: Early Access Release 1
notes.notes: [p]I'm uploading today because I said I would. [/p][p][/p][p]I scrapped everything and started over April 2025. This release is around 4-5 months of work.[/p][p]The Cartographer is now a 2D app. Very limited space sim game play.  All you can do right now is fly through star systems you create. [/p][p][/p][p]I wanted to have a functioning galaxy up and running with enemies to engage with and space stations to dock at with today's upload. Unfortunately I've had things in my personal life I needed to deal with. The plan was to have another update next month, end of September 2025, but now I'm gong to have to release several updates throughout September to get to where I wanted to be now. I understand people are going to be disappointed. There were several days I had scheduled to work on this but wasn't able to due to things beyond my control. That's why I'm behind. [/p][p][/p][p]The hull designer has been removed from this build because creating 3D models and then importing them into the game increases RAM the game uses more than I'm comfortable with. So I'm going to rework it and the Hull Designer will be back in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p]The default launch option opens the Cartographer. Pressing the "Play" button from Steam library will bring up launch options. Choose the second one to fly around in star systems you create. Right now it's simply a flying camera. The Space Sim part of the game currently is hard coded to only load a star system named "Rigel". [/p][p]Star systems you create with the Cartographer will be saved in "Documents/My Games/SpaceTimeShipyard/StarSystems/[/p][p][/p][p]Pressing the ESC key in the space sim will freeze the game and bring up the menu. Currently the options are to adjust the LOD system for asteroid fields and change keyboard controls. Obviously there is so much more to be added. [/p][p]The default controls are W - Forward, S- Stop, A - turn left, D - turn right[/p][p][/p][p]I apologize I really wanted to have so much more for this update. I'm going to try to release a minor update on September 4th, next week and more throughout the month of September to get the game to where it was supposed to be today. [/p][p]Edit: 9/6/2025: The next minor update will be uploaded next week. [/p][p][/p][p]Asteroid field position is correct but they're too big I need to adjust the scaling. [/p][p]Planet destruction is disabled as I need to adjust it. I mention that because I showed in in a trailer. [/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Add Star Systems You Want To The Game's Galaxy & Nebulas
notes.notes: [p]Nebula have been added. A nebula cloud's color determine its properties and what effect if has on ships  flying through them. Will this nebula cause havoc with your sensors, weaken your shields, or something else?[/p][p][/p][p]The video in this post shows changes made to the Cartographer. It's now a 2D app that ships with the game. Players will be able to set the altitude axis of stellar objects in the star systems they create using a slider in the Cartographer.  In the video I create a simple star system and fly through it. The music in the video will be in the game. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="maP7SVJw8AQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Getting Closer To A Major Update!
notes.notes: [p]My goal is to have the major update out before September 2025. It will still be in early access after the update. I redid the Cartographer, (the level editor), for designing star systems. The star systems are going to be humongous! Traveling the impulse speed of the USS Enterprise in this game will take the player more than 10 hours (in real life sitting in front of the computer) to travel from one side of any star system to another! Don't worry there will be faster than light travel options even in star systems ;)   Well... if you have the fuel.[/p][p]Lately I've been working on the asteroid fields. The video in this post shows flying through a star system designed using the Cartographer in game. In the video there are four asteroid fields each with several thousands of space rocks. In the Cartographer players will be able to set the density of asteroid fields. For testing purposes each of the four asteroid fields was set to maximum density. When all four asteroid fields became fully visible the FPS tanked to 10! I still need to clean that up. The video is just a test. [/p][previewyoutube="YVTmvbVRVSQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Edit: It's past 2am in the morning where I am July 31, 2025.[/p][p]I just finished coding some improvements to the asteroid fields which has greatly improved the FPS. There are over 19,000 individual asteroids in the star system in this video! Each one is a 3D model that can be interacted with. It's better than the previous video (above) but still needs improving. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="YnRNInK7hY4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Another update and controls explained
notes.notes:
Camera movement updated - it was too slow

[u]Controls[/u]

Left mouse button  --- select controls and place pieces by clicking on red connection nodes

Right mouse button --- hold down to rotate camera around ship being built

MIddle mouse button --- hold down and drag to move ship model to position desired

Mouse Scroll Wheel --- roll forward and back to zoom in and out

After saving a design the 3d OBJ model and textures are saved to the directory Documents/My Games/4X Space Time Shipyard/

:)

Press escape key to exit application.

notes.title: Importing OBJ models created by 4XST Shipyard into other 3d modelers
notes.notes: 4XST Shipyard exports OBJ models correctly and they can be imported into other 3d modelers along with textures. For a unknown reason Microsoft's 3D Builder app does not import the textures correctly. This is a Microsoft issue as other 3d modelers have no problem importing the textures as well and applying them to the ship model.
